newsitem.title: UK: ScotPower advertises in south for gas buyers.
newsitem.headline: ScotPower advertises in south for gas buyers.

text.p: British multi-utility Scottish Power has kicked off a television advertising campaign aimed at persudading customers of its subsidiary Southern Water to buy gas from it when trials start in south east England in March.
In a statement, the company said it intended to take part in the regional gas supply trials which are a practice run before full liberalistion of the market in 1998.
Southern Electric, which bowed out of competition with Scottish Power's 1.68 billion stg takeover of Southern Water in June, will also be competing in the trials.
Scottish Power said about 900,000 customers would have the chance to switch to its supply with savings of up to 25 percent on household bills.
It said it would give 30 stg rebates to customers joining the scheme before January 31.
Around 500,000 households in south west England are already undergoing trials and next year's move will see a further 1.5 million customers shopping around.
